trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: If only we listened to the coach!
trap.right: If only we had listened to the coach!
trap.why: Arrependimento do passado: if only + had + particípio. O brasileiro usa o passado simples.

mcq.q: If only we **___** to the coach!
She wishes he **___** call more often.

fix.right: If only he would call me!

fix.wrong: If only I knew the answer yesterday!
fix.right: If only I had known the answer yesterday!

fix.wrong: I wish she will smile more.
fix.right: I wish she would smile more.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “We lost the game.” (If only we… not)
rewrite.answer: If only we hadn’t lost the game!
